sentences.text: No: clause 9.3 provides a pre-payment charge of 3% of principal outstanding on pre-payment or foreclosure, while the applicable UCB rule finding says prepayment charge is not applicable for this case.
The agreement also shows the loan was sanctioned on 10 February 2026 for a home loan term loan for purchase of a residential flat for self-occupation and not for business.
The older RBI pre-payment directions relied on in the record are no longer in force, because they were superseded or withdrawn before the as-of date.
